sources.query: SELECT BANK_KEY_CODE, BANK_NAME, PHONE_NUM, TAX_NUMBER, CONTACT_NAME, BANK_USER_NAME, BANK_TYPE_CODE, BANK_TYPE_NAME, BANK_CAT_CODE, BANK_CAT_NAME, BANK_ID, ACCDET_ID, ACCDET_NAME, BANK_ACCT_NUM, BANK_ACCT_ALT_NUM, BANK_ALT_NUM, BANK_ALT_NAME, COUNTRY_CODE, COUNTRY_NAME, COUNTRY_REGION, STATE_CODE, STATE_NAME, STATE_REGION, POSTAL_CODE, COUNTY, STREET_ADDRESS1, STREET_ADDRESS2, CITY, SWIFT_NAME, SWIFT_CODE, BANK_HIER_CODE, BANK_HIER_NAME, BANK_NUMBER, BANK_BRANCH_CODE, BANK_BRANCH_NAME, ACTIVE_FLG, CREATED_BY_ID, CHANGED_BY_ID, CREATED_ON_DT, CHANGED_ON_DT, AUX1_CHANGED_ON_DT, AUX2_CHANGED_ON_DT, AUX3_CHANGED_ON_DT, AUX4_CHANGED_ON_DT, SRC_EFF_FROM_DT, SRC_EFF_TO_DT, DELETE_FLG, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, INTEGRATION_ID, SET_ID, TENANT_ID, X_CUSTOM, BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, PRIMARY_FLAG, END_DATE FROM POC.W_BANK_DS

-- NOTE: $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] is a DataOps dataflow parameter substituting for the Informatica mapping/session parameter $$DATASOURCE_NUM_ID; it is currently a placeholder (0) and MUST be corrected to the real value before results are trusted.
-- NOTE: this recompute follows the SESSION-LEVEL SQL override of SQ_AP_BANK_ACCOUNTS_ALL (which populates the branch view's LAST_UPDATE_DATE from bankorgprofile.last_update_date), not the mapping-level default SQL (which hardcodes that column to NULL). The session override is what actually executes at runtime.
-- NOTE: intentionally omits the session-level incremental predicate (bank-account/branch LAST_UPDATE_DATE > $$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE) -- that only controls which rows are pulled in a given incremental run, not permanent row membership, so a steady-state comparison should not apply it. The SYSDATE-based effective-date filters on the bank/branch hierarchy ARE kept because they are permanent business rules -- but they are evaluated "as of now", so a bank/branch whose effective_end_date has since lapsed will silently disappear from a re-run of this query even though a previously-loaded row may still sit in the target; treat such gaps as expected drift, not defects.
-- NOTE: TENANT_ID and X_CUSTOM are set to NULL here (not $$TENANT_ID) because HHS_mplt_SA_ORA_BankDimension's INP_TENANT_ID / INP_X_CUSTOM input ports are never fed a value from the main mapping (Exp_Integration_ID computes TENANT_ID = IIF(ISNULL(INP_TENANT_ID),$$TENANT_ID,INP_TENANT_ID) but that output only flows into Filter, which does not forward it into the SA mapplet). The same dead-port pattern applies to AUX2/AUX3/AUX4_CHANGED_ON_DT (only AUX1 is wired through, from the branch's last_update_date). Re-verify this against the live repository before assuming $$TENANT_ID is truly unused.
-- NOTE: COUNTY is set to the branch STATE value (not branchparty.province) because EXP_BANKS' IIF(ISNULL(INP_COUNTY), INP_STATE, INP_COUNTY) always takes the INP_STATE branch -- INP_COUNTY is never fed a value from upstream.
-- NOTE: BANK_CAT_CODE is the source's raw BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE column (account subtype, e.g. CHECKING/SAVINGS), NOT the INTERNAL/EXTERNAL account_type literal (that literal is only used to build INTEGRATION_ID and the dedup key, and is never itself loaded to target).
-- NOTE: BANK_BRANCH_CODE is mapped from BANK_BRANCH_NAME per EXT_BANK_BRANCH_CODE's expression (there is no separate branch-code source column).
-- NOTE: CONTACT_NAME / PHONE_NUM come from CE_CONTACT_ASSIGNMENTS -> HZ_RELATIONSHIPS(RELATIONSHIP_CODE='CONTACT_OF') -> HZ_PARTIES. A bank account can have multiple linked contacts, fanning out the driving query; Informatica's REJECT_FLAG/Filter logic keeps only the first row per BANK_ACCOUNT_ID after "ORDER BY BANK_ACCOUNT_ID" with no secondary sort key, so the "winning" contact is whichever the source DB happens to return first -- inherently non-deterministic. This recompute uses ROW_NUMBER() partitioned by bank_account_id and ordered by relationship_id as a best-effort deterministic stand-in; expect occasional CONTACT_NAME/PHONE_NUM mismatches for accounts with multiple contacts even when everything else matches. Single-contact and no-contact accounts should compare cleanly.
-- NOTE: BANK_KEY_CODE, COUNTRY_REGION, STATE_CODE, STATE_REGION, POSTAL_CODE, STREET_ADDRESS2, DELETE_FLG, SET_ID have no connector into W_BANK_DS anywhere in this workflow and are included below as NULL purely for full target-column coverage.
WITH bank_branch AS (
  SELECT
    bankorgprofile.organization_name AS bank_name,
    bankorgprofile.bank_or_branch_number AS bank_number,
    branchparty.party_id AS bank_branch_id,
    branchparty.party_name AS bank_branch_name,
    branchparty.address1 AS address_line1,
    branchparty.address2 AS address_line2,
    branchparty.address3 AS address_line3,
    branchparty.city AS city,
    branchparty.province AS county,
    branchparty.state AS state,
    branchparty.country AS country,
    bankca.class_code AS institution_type,
    bankorgprofile.last_update_date AS branch_last_update_date
  FROM hz_organization_profiles bankorgprofile
  JOIN hz_code_assignments bankca
    ON bankca.owner_table_id = bankorgprofile.party_id
   AND bankca.owner_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES'
   AND bankca.class_category = 'BANK_INSTITUTION_TYPE'
   AND bankca.class_code IN ('BANK','CLEARINGHOUSE')
   AND NVL(bankca.status,'A') = 'A'
  JOIN hz_relationships brrel
    ON brrel.object_id = bankorgprofile.party_id
   AND brrel.relationship_type = 'BANK_AND_BRANCH'
   AND brrel.relationship_code = 'BRANCH_OF'
   AND brrel.status = 'A'
   AND brrel.subject_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES'
   AND brrel.subject_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
   AND brrel.object_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES'
   AND brrel.object_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
  JOIN hz_parties branchparty
    ON branchparty.party_id = brrel.subject_id
   AND branchparty.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
   AND branchparty.status = 'A'
  JOIN hz_organization_profiles branchorgprofile
    ON branchorgprofile.party_id = branchparty.party_id
   AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TRUNC(branchorgprofile.effective_start_date) AND NVL(TRUNC(branchorgprofile.effective_end_date), SYSDATE + 1)
  JOIN hz_code_assignments branchca
    ON branchca.owner_table_id = branchparty.party_id
   AND branchca.owner_table_name = 'HZ_PARTIES'
   AND branchca.class_category = 'BANK_INSTITUTION_TYPE'
   AND branchca.class_code IN ('BANK_BRANCH','CLEARINGHOUSE_BRANCH')
   AND NVL(branchca.status,'A') = 'A'
  WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN TRUNC(bankorgprofile.effective_start_date) AND NVL(TRUNC(bankorgprofile.effective_end_date), SYSDATE + 1)
),
bank_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS bank_account_id,
    ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT AS bank_account_name_alt,
    ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM AS bank_account_number,
    ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE AS bank_account_type,
    'INTERNAL' AS account_type,
    ACC.ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME AS account_holder_name,
    ACC.BANK_BRANCH_ID AS bank_branch_id,
    ACC.CREATION_DATE AS creation_date,
    ACC.CREATED_BY AS created_by,
    ACC.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS last_update_date,
    ACC.LAST_UPDATED_BY AS last_updated_by,
    ACC.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME AS bank_account_name,
    ACC.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE AS agency_location_code,
    'Y' AS primary_flag,
    ACC.END_DATE AS end_date
  FROM CE_BANK_ACCOUNTS ACC
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    EB.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID AS bank_account_id,
    EB.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME_ALT AS bank_account_name_alt,
    EB.MASKED_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM AS bank_account_number,
    EB.BANK_ACCOUNT_TYPE AS bank_account_type,
    'EXTERNAL' AS account_type,
    TO_CHAR(NULL) AS account_holder_name,
    EB.BRANCH_ID AS bank_branch_id,
    EB.CREATION_DATE AS creation_date,
    EB.CREATED_BY AS created_by,
    EB.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS last_update_date,
    EB.LAST_UPDATED_BY AS last_updated_by,
    EB.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME AS bank_account_name,
    EB.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE AS agency_location_code,
    OW.PRIMARY_FLAG AS primary_flag,
    OW.END_DATE AS end_date
  FROM IBY_EXT_BANK_ACCOUNTS EB
  LEFT JOIN IBY_ACCOUNT_OWNERS OW
    ON EB.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = OW.EXT_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
   AND OW.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y'
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    BA.*,
    BB.bank_name, BB.bank_number, BB.bank_branch_name, BB.address_line1, BB.address_line2, BB.address_line3,
    BB.city, BB.county, BB.state, BB.country, BB.institution_type, BB.branch_last_update_date,
    HP.PARTY_NAME AS contact_name,
    PR.PRIMARY_PHONE_AREA_CODE AS contact_phone_area_code,
    PR.PRIMARY_PHONE_NUMBER AS contact_phone_number,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BA.bank_account_id ORDER BY HR.RELATIONSHIP_ID NULLS LAST) AS rn
  FROM bank_accounts BA
  JOIN bank_branch BB ON BA.bank_branch_id = BB.bank_branch_id
  LEFT JOIN CE_CONTACT_ASSIGNMENTS CA ON BA.bank_account_id = CA.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
  LEFT JOIN HZ_RELATIONSHIPS HR ON CA.RELATIONSHIP_ID = HR.RELATIONSHIP_ID AND HR.RELATIONSHIP_CODE = 'CONTACT_OF'
  LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTIES HP ON HR.SUBJECT_ID = HP.PARTY_ID
  LEFT JOIN HZ_PARTIES PR ON HR.PARTY_ID = PR.PARTY_ID
)
SELECT
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS BANK_KEY_CODE,
  bank_name AS BANK_NAME,
  (contact_phone_area_code || '-' || contact_phone_number) AS PHONE_NUM,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS TAX_NUMBER,
  contact_name AS CONTACT_NAME,
  account_holder_name AS BANK_USER_NAME,
  institution_type AS BANK_TYPE_CODE,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS BANK_TYPE_NAME,
  bank_account_type AS BANK_CAT_CODE,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS BANK_CAT_NAME,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS BANK_ID,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS ACCDET_ID,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS ACCDET_NAME,
  bank_account_number AS BANK_ACCT_NUM,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS BANK_ACCT_ALT_NUM,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS BANK_ALT_NUM,
  bank_account_name_alt AS BANK_ALT_NAME,
  country AS COUNTRY_CODE,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS COUNTRY_NAME,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS COUNTRY_REGION,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS STATE_CODE,
  state AS STATE_NAME,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS STATE_REGION,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS POSTAL_CODE,
  state AS COUNTY,
  address_line1 AS STREET_ADDRESS1,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS STREET_ADDRESS2,
  city AS CITY,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS SWIFT_NAME,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS SWIFT_CODE,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS BANK_HIER_CODE,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS BANK_HIER_NAME,
  bank_number AS BANK_NUMBER,
  bank_branch_name AS BANK_BRANCH_CODE,
  bank_branch_name AS BANK_BRANCH_NAME,
  'Y' AS ACTIVE_FLG,
  TO_CHAR(created_by) AS CREATED_BY_ID,
  TO_CHAR(last_updated_by) AS CHANGED_BY_ID,
  creation_date AS CREATED_ON_DT,
  last_update_date AS CHANGED_ON_DT,
  branch_last_update_date AS AUX1_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS AUX2_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS AUX3_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS AUX4_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  TO_DATE('18990101','YYYYMMDD') AS SRC_EFF_FROM_DT,
  CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS SRC_EFF_TO_DT,
  CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS DELETE_FLG,
  $[DATASOURCE_NUM_ID] AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
  (CASE WHEN account_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN 'E' ELSE 'I' END) || '~' || TO_CHAR(bank_account_id) AS INTEGRATION_ID,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30)) AS SET_ID,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(80)) AS TENANT_ID,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS X_CUSTOM,
  bank_account_name AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,
  agency_location_code AS AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE,
  primary_flag AS PRIMARY_FLAG,
  end_date AS END_DATE
FROM joined
WHERE rn = 1
